title: Spiderweb Trees
statementMd:
Let's call a graph with $n$ vertices, each of which has it's own point $A_i = (x_i, y_i)$ with integer coordinates, a *planar tree* if:

- All points $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_n$ are different and no three points lie on the same line.
- The graph is a tree, i.e. there are exactly $n-1$ edges there exists a path between any pair of vertices.
- For all pairs of edges $(s_1, f_1)$ and $(s_2, f_2)$, such that $s_1 \neq s_2, s_1 \neq f_2,$ $f_1 \neq s_2$, and $f_1 \neq f_2$, the segments $A_{s_1} A_{f_1}$ and $A_{s_2} A_{f_2}$ don't intersect.

Imagine a planar tree with $n$ vertices. Consider the convex hull of points $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_n$. Let's call this tree a *spiderweb tree* if for all $1 \leq i \leq n$ the following statements are true:

- All leaves (vertices with degree $\leq 1$) of the tree lie on the border of the convex hull.
- All vertices on the border of the convex hull are leaves.

An example of a spiderweb tree:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a10298dd37df764bbb90572ed7fa84ad621cc358.png)

The points $A_3, A_6, A_7, A_4$ lie on the convex hull and the leaf vertices of the tree are $3, 6, 7, 4$.

Refer to the notes for more examples.

Let's call the subset $S \subset \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}$ of vertices a *subtree* of the tree if for all pairs of vertices in $S$, there exists a path that contains only vertices from $S$. Note that any subtree of the planar tree is a planar tree.

You are given a planar tree with $n$ vertexes. Let's call a partition of the set $\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}$ into non-empty subsets $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_k$ (i.e. $A_i \cap A_j = \emptyset$ for all $1 \leq i \lt j \leq k$ and $A_1 \cup A_2 \cup \ldots \cup A_k = \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}$) good if for all $1 \leq i \leq k$, the subtree $A_i$ is a spiderweb tree. Two partitions are different if there exists some set that lies in one parition, but not the other.

Find the number of good partitions. Since this number can be very large, find it modulo $998\,244\,353$.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 100$) — the number of vertices in the tree.

The next $n$ lines each contain two integers $x_i, y_i$ ($-10^9 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10^9$)  — the coordinates of $i$-th vertex, $A_i$.

The next $n-1$ lines contain two integers $s, f$ ($1 \leq s, f \leq n$) — the edges $(s, f)$ of the tree.

It is guaranteed that all given points are different and that no three of them lie at the same line. Additionally, it is guaranteed that the given edges and coordinates of the points describe a planar tree.

## Output

Print one integer  — the number of good partitions of vertices of the given planar tree, modulo $998\,244\,353$.

## Note

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d7a8a1c8c105c85b5cb3b049d55be85317de2fed.png) The picture for the first sample.

In the first test case, all good partitions are:

1. $\{1\}$, $\{2\}$, $\{3\}$, $\{4\}$;
2. $\{1, 2\}$, $\{3\}$, $\{4\}$;
3. $\{1, 3\}$, $\{2\}$, $\{4\}$;
4. $\{1, 4\}$, $\{2\}$, $\{3\}$;
5. $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$.

The partition $\{1, 2, 3\}$, $\{4\}$ isn't good, because the subtree $\{1, 2, 3\}$ isn't spiderweb tree, since the non-leaf vertex $1$ lies on the convex hull.

The partition $\{2, 3, 4\}$, $\{1\}$ isn't good, because the subset $\{2, 3, 4\}$ isn't a subtree.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6c0ab03e47c4594bb7ec8ae0d70644739770a53f.png) The picture for the second sample.

In the second test case, the given tree isn't a spiderweb tree, because the leaf vertex $1$ doesn't lie on the convex hull. However, the subtree $\{2, 3, 4, 5\}$ is a spiderweb tree.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d5f3aa460b3f29423353a4a540cb2790c819e61a.png) The picture for the third sample.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/da72c6e0a2fae395bedfe9e25c6459710a465102.png) The picture for the fourth sample.

In the fourth test case, the partition $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$, $\{5, 6, 7, 8\}$ is good because all subsets are spiderweb subtrees.
statementZhMd:
称一个具有 $n$ 个顶点的图为一棵*平面树*，其中每个顶点都有一个对应的整数坐标点 $A_i = (x_i, y_i)$，当且仅当满足以下条件：

- 所有点 $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_n$ 均不相同，且不存在三点共线。
- 该图是一棵树，即恰有 $n-1$ 条边，且任意两个顶点之间都存在一条路径。
- 对于任意两条边 $(s_1, f_1)$ 和 $(s_2, f_2)$，如果 $s_1 \neq s_2, s_1 \neq f_2,$ $f_1 \neq s_2$ 且 $f_1 \neq f_2$，线段 $A_{s_1} A_{f_1}$ 与 $A_{s_2} A_{f_2}$ 不相交。

考虑一棵具有 $n$ 个顶点的平面树。设点 $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_n$ 的凸包为该树的凸包。如果对于所有 $1 \leq i \leq n$，以下条件均成立，则称这棵树为一棵*蜘蛛网树*：

- 树中的所有叶子（度数 $\leq 1$ 的顶点）都位于凸包的边界上。
- 所有位于凸包边界上的顶点都是叶子。

下面是一棵蜘蛛网树的示例：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a10298dd37df764bbb90572ed7fa84ad621cc358.png)

点 $A_3, A_6, A_7, A_4$ 位于凸包上，树的叶子顶点为 $3, 6, 7, 4$。

更多示例请参见说明部分。

如果顶点的子集 $S \subset \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}$ 中任意两个顶点之间都存在一条仅包含 $S$ 中顶点的路径，则称 $S$ 是这棵树的一个*子树*。注意，平面树的任意子树都是一棵平面树。

给定一棵具有 $n$ 个顶点的平面树。将集合 $\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}$ 划分为若干个非空子集 $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_k$（即对于所有 $1 \leq i \lt j \leq k$，都有 $A_i \cap A_j = \emptyset$，且 $A_1 \cup A_2 \cup \ldots \cup A_k = \{1, 2, \ldots, n\}$）。如果对于所有 $1 \leq i \leq k$，子树 $A_i$ 都是一棵蜘蛛网树，则称该划分是*好的*。如果存在某个集合只出现在其中一个划分中，则称两个划分不同。

求好的划分数量。由于答案可能很大，请对 $998\,244\,353$ 取模。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \leq n \leq 100$）——树中的顶点数。

接下来 $n$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $x_i, y_i$（$-10^9 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10^9$）——第 $i$ 个顶点 $A_i$ 的坐标。

接下来 $n-1$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $s, f$（$1 \leq s, f \leq n$）——树中的一条边 $(s, f)$。

保证所有给定的点均不相同，且不存在三点共线。此外，保证给定的边和点的坐标描述了一棵平面树。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——给定平面树的顶点的好的划分数量，对 $998\,244\,353$ 取模。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d7a8a1c8c105c85b5cb3b049d55be85317de2fed.png) 第一组样例的图示。

在第一组测试中，所有好的划分如下：

1. $\{1\}$、$\{2\}$、$\{3\}$、$\{4\}$；
2. $\{1, 2\}$、$\{3\}$、$\{4\}$；
3. $\{1, 3\}$、$\{2\}$、$\{4\}$；
4. $\{1, 4\}$、$\{2\}$、$\{3\}$；
5. $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$。

划分 $\{1, 2, 3\}$、$\{4\}$ 不是好的，因为子树 $\{1, 2, 3\}$ 不是蜘蛛网树：非叶子顶点 $1$ 位于凸包上。

划分 $\{2, 3, 4\}$、$\{1\}$ 不是好的，因为子集 $\{2, 3, 4\}$ 不是一棵子树。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6c0ab03e47c4594bb7ec8ae0d70644739770a53f.png) 第二组样例的图示。

在第二组测试中，给定的树不是蜘蛛网树，因为叶子顶点 $1$ 不位于凸包上。然而，子树 $\{2, 3, 4, 5\}$ 是一棵蜘蛛网树。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d5f3aa460b3f29423353a4a540cb2790c819e61a.png) 第三组样例的图示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/da72c6e0a2fae395bedfe9e25c6459710a465102.png) 第四组样例的图示。

在第四组测试中，划分 $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$、$\{5, 6, 7, 8\}$ 是好的，因为所有子集都是蜘蛛网子树。
